title: White Skips 3.Nc3 (3.Nf3, 3.d4, 3.c4)
intro: If White skips 3.Nc3, take advantage of the extra time: pin with 3...Bg4 against 3.Nf3, hit d4 with 3...Nc6 against 3.d4, and meet 3.c4 with 3...Qa5.
variation: e2e4 d7d5 e4d5 d8d5 g1f3, e2e4 d7d5 e4d5 d8d5 d2d4, e2e4 d7d5 e4d5 d8d5 c2c4

lessons.title: Meeting 3.Nf3
lessons.summary: Pin with 3...Bg4, develop ...Nc6, and castle queenside.

steps.text: Sometimes White skips 3.Nc3 and develops 3.Nf3 first.
With your queen safe in the centre for now, pin the knight immediately.
steps.hint: Put your c8 bishop on g4.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3...Bg4 to pin the knight and prepare ...Nc6 and ...O-O-O.
steps.ifRight: Black gets rapid development and pressure on White's centre.

steps.text: Develop your queen's knight and prepare queenside castling.
steps.hint: Bring the b8 knight to c6.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4...Nc6 to aim at d4 and e5 and clear the queenside.
steps.ifRight: Black is ready to castle long with ...O-O-O.

steps.text: Get your king safe and line up a rook on the d-file against d4.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5...O-O-O: your rook immediately pressures d4.
steps.ifRight: Black gets an active game with ...Nf6 and ...e5 or ...Qh5.

lessons.title: Meeting 3.d4 and 3.Be2
lessons.summary: Pressure d4 at once with 3...Nc6 and 4...Bg4.

steps.text: If White plays 3.d4 right away, the d4 pawn is unprotected.

steps.hint: Develop your queen's knight to c6.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3...Nc6 (or 3...e5) to pressure d4 right away.
steps.ifRight: White must defend d4 instead of chasing your queen.

steps.hint: Put your c8 bishop on g4.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4...Bg4 to renew the threat on d4.
steps.ifRight: Black follows with ...O-O-O and strong pressure on d4.

steps.text: Against 3.Be2, White has left the g2 pawn without a guard. Punish it.
steps.hint: Your queen on d5 can reach g2.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3...Qxg2: the pawn is free, and if 4.Bf3 the queen simply steps back.
steps.ifRight: A clean extra pawn. Develop next with ...Nc6 and ...Bg4.

steps.text: If White defends d4 with 4.Be3, strike at the centre.
steps.hint: Push ...e5 to challenge d4 right away.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4...e5 (or 4...Nf6) to open lines while White is behind in development.
steps.ifRight: After 4...e5, Black gets easy piece play.

lessons.title: Meeting 3.c4
lessons.summary: Step back to a5 and target the weakened d4 square with ...c6 and ...Nf6.

steps.text: With 3.c4, White drives your queen away with a pawn move, yet weakens the d4 square forever.
Move your queen to its familiar Scandinavian square.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3...Qa5 (or 3...Qd6) to keep eyeing the centre.
steps.ifRight: Since White already pushed c4, the d4 square will be a lasting target.

steps.text: Prepare ...Bf5 or ...Nf6 and keep d5 guarded.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4...c6 (or 4...Nf6) to keep your queen flexible and eye d5.

steps.text: White builds a big centre with 5.d4.
Develop your king's knight and get ready to target d4.
steps.hint: Bring the g8 knight to f6.
steps.ifRight: Black gets a solid position and can challenge d4 with ...e5 or ...Bg4.
